r4-quality.title: Quality vs inherited rules
r4-quality.imperative: Does the change meet the inherited project/section rules (the handoff's constraints)? Append a check per rule. Record pass/fail with a finding.
r4-quality.finding: One genuine NEW project-standard violation, independently reproduced: 'py -m src.utils.simplification_limits --paths src/physics/layer2/estimate_store.py src/physics/layer2/session_race.py' -> FAIL, 2 violations. Of the 2, session_race.py's file_lines=1366 (limit <1000) and load_race_stints=170 lines are BOTH PRE-EXISTING (confirmed via git-stash-and-rerun against HEAD: session_race.py was already 1268 lines / already over the limit before this diff touched it, and load_race_stints is untouched by this diff) -- not this gate's defect. BUT tests/unit/physics/layer2/test_estimate_store.py crossed the threshold BECAUSE of this diff: 888 lines at HEAD (under the <1000 limit) -> 1005 lines after the +117-line #513 addition (now over it). CREW_CONTEXT.md's Verification-By-Region section states this check is required for every source change and is an explicit 'Review blocker when skipped or failing on in-scope Python' -- the implementer's evidence never ran/reported this check. Severity: MEDIUM/should-fix, not a functional or correctness defect (purely a line-count lint threshold on a test file, 5 lines over) -- remediation is trivial (split the new #513 G3 test class into a companion file, e.g. test_estimate_store_track_laps.py). All OTHER CREW_CONTEXT rules checked and PASS: physics-region import boundary clean (no evo/latent_power/compound_prior/fastf1 imports in either src file, grepped and confirmed empty), no module-level mutable state or DB singleton introduced, missingness handled intentionally (None returned + explicit no_lap counter, never zero-filled/guessed), no print() added to src/ (grep found only pre-existing print() calls elsewhere in session_race.py, none in the new diff hunks), self-heal migration is the same generic dataclass-field-driven ALTER mechanism as mass_kg_assumed (no special-casing).
